span.p:
ToolkitHome

Singleton registry of all toolkits.
Resolves name to class,
imports and instantiates.

getToolkit(name, project)
registerToolkit()
getToolkitTable()

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Project

Central data-access layer.
Wraps 3 MongoDB collections.

addDocument / getDocuments
setConfig / getConfig
counters, filesDirectory

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
abstractToolkit

Base class for all toolkits.
Inherits from Project.

toolkitName, analysis, presentation
addDataSource / getDataSourceData
versioned datasource management
